name: Big Springs Water Trail Launch

attributes.recarea_description: This is a great location for visitors to fish, float, and enjoy the Henry's Fork of the Ske River.

reviewNote: The Forest Service boating-site point identifies the trestle-side approach. The USFS recreation guide and HFF study identify a hand-carry launch here. The shoreline connection is not surveyed.
imageryReview: Compared source location with satellite imagery and named access guidance.

name: Big Springs Water Trail Public Takeout

attributes.recarea_description: Take out for the Big Springs Water Trail

reviewNote: The HFF/Caribou-Targhee field study, Figure 3 on page 8, identifies the public clearing. The USFS facility coordinate is about 90 m east near cabins, so this approximate area center was placed in the depicted clearing using satellite imagery. Original agency geometry is preserved in the review binding; this is not an exact landing fix.
imageryReview: Compared source location with satellite imagery and named access guidance.

areaCenter.feature: Designated public takeout clearing shown in HFF/USFS field-study Figure 3

placementReview.note: Deliberate approximate relocation to the depicted public clearing. Original source geometry remains unchanged in feature.
